agents.description: Investigate AWS ALB 5xx alerts. Two-phase: fast RCA identifies the failing service/API/error in ~20s, deep RCA traces full root cause chain with ES logs and dependency checks. Covers: ALB5xxErrors, HTTPCode_Target_5XX_Count, HTTPCode_ELB_5XX_Count, HTTP_ELB_CODE_5XX, Protocol API ALB 5xx.

Investigate AWS RDS (shared by AWS+GCP apps) alerts: high CPU utilization, high database connections, low freeable memory, high IOPS. Uses CloudWatch, Performance Insights, slow query logs, and Kubernetes pod logs. For alerts: RDSHighCPU, RDSHighConnections, RDSLowMemory.

Investigate AWS RDS (shared by AWS+GCP apps) replication lag alerts: logical replication slot lag (AWS→GCP cross-cloud), Aurora read replica lag, WAL disk growth. Distinguishes stale logical slots (100+ days lag) from Aurora replica lag (<100ms). For alerts: RDSReplicationLag, ReplicationSlotLag, AuroraReplicaLag, OldestReplicationSlotLag.

Investigate AWS ElastiCache Redis alerts: high CPU, high memory, key evictions, high connections, bandwidth saturation, CLUSTERDOWN. Covers: RedisHighCPU, RedisHighMemory, RedisEvictions, RedisHighConnections, Redis Node Memory beyond 90%, ProtocolRedis-CPU.

Investigate GCP Memorystore for Redis alerts: high CPU, high memory, key evictions, high connections, network saturation. Uses redis-cli INFO/SLOWLOG (read-only) as the primary diagnostic, Prometheus-mirrored Memorystore metrics, and gcloud redis for instance state. For alerts: MemorystoreHighCPU, MemorystoreHighMemory, MemorystoreEvictions, RedisHighMemory (GCP).

Investigate GCP HTTP(S) Load Balancer 5xx alerts. Distinguishes backend 5xx (app error) from LB-generated 5xx (backend unhealthy/timeout) via response_code_class and gcloud compute backend-services get-health. Uses Prometheus app metrics as the primary signal, plus ES logs and gcloud compute for LB state. For alerts: GCLB5xx, LoadBalancer5xx, HTTPSLB5xx, Protocol5xx (GCP).

Investigate all drainer alerts: NoDriverDrainerRunning, NoAppDrainerRunning, NoDriverDrainerPodRunning, NoCustomerDrainerPodRunning, DriverDrainerLagIncreasing, CustomerDrainerLagIncreasing. Covers: pods down (OOM/eviction), SQL errors (integer overflow, varchar overflow), DB connectivity, Redis cluster issues, false alarms, and drainer lag.

Investigate ProducerNotProducing alert for driver job producer. Determines if producer is genuinely down or false alarm (stale metric). Checks pod status, producer metrics, stream jobs counter, and allocator health.
Investigate SystemConfigParseFailure — identifies which service/event is failing, checks if it's Redis cache decode failures (baseline noise) or a real config issue from deployment/config push.
Investigate LoginSuccessRate alert — auth verify success rate dropped. Checks auth handler metrics, OTP delivery, Redis (session cache), DB health, and recent deployments.

General deep investigation for alerts without dedicated fast-RCA: TrinetraTriggered, Multimodal5xx, Protocol5xxErrors, ProtocolExternalAPI5xx, AcmeGateway5xx, OpenNetworkGateway5xx, GRPCDown, GIMS5xx, CMRLAPIGivingErrors, CrisAPIGivingErrors, PTExternalAPIErrorsIncreased, Refunds increased. Covers 5xx errors, external API failures, job failures, and business metric alerts.

Investigate RideToSearchRatioDown alert — business metric drop. First verifies metrics are flowing, then checks search/ride pipeline: 5xx on search handlers, allocator health, external API failures (OpenNetwork/Acme/Google Maps), driver supply, and compares with yesterday baseline.

Deep domain debugging: trace application issues through database + source code. Given a ride/booking/payment UUID, resolves the full entity chain, finds the anomaly, then reads the actual Haskell backend code from /data/example-app-src/ to explain WHY the code behaved that way. Covers: rides, bookings, payments, drivers, riders, fare issues, cancellations, search failures.

Investigate AllocatorLooksDead alert for ride matching allocator. Determines if allocator is genuinely dead or false alarm, checks dependencies (location-redis, driver RDS, Kafka), compares errors against yesterday's baseline to filter noise.
Fallback for SEV2 alerts not caught by specific runbooks. Uses general investigation methodology.
